$about: Встроенный английский «Очага» (docs/I18N.md). Слева — русский текст по умолчанию: это ключ, его не меняйте. Справа — перевод.
Пустая строка "" — ещё не переведено: в интерфейсе останется русский текст.
{имя} — подстановка (число, имя, название): перенесите её в перевод как есть, порядок слов — любой. {{ и }} — просто фигурные скобки.
Разделы — файлы, где встречается строка («Общие» — в нескольких местах). На перевод не влияют: одинаковый текст переводится один раз.
Перевод виден там, где интерфейс уже подключён к переводу (t() в коде); остальные строки заработают, когда их компонент переведут на t(), — ключ останется тем же.
Посмотреть сразу: npm run dev — обновляется на лету; или скопируйте файл в папку языков («Настройки интерфейса» → «Язык» → «Папка языков») и нажмите «Обновить список».
Новые строки добавляет npm run i18n:extract (пустыми); уже переведённое он не трогает.

components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.Мастер выбирает рецепт и начинает пригот: The GM picks a recipe and starts the brewing. The cauldron appears for everyone in the campaign.
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.попасть в диапазон жара рецепта, набрать: hit the recipe’s heat range, reach exactly the essence it needs and at least the stability it lists. Then click “Pour”.
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.Начальные свойства: жар 2, эссенция 0, у: Starting properties: heat 2, essence 0, stability 3. There are two portions of each ingredient. Their effects are shown on the cards and apply at once.
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.Добавление ингредиента, подогрев, охлажд: Adding an ingredient, heating, cooling and stirring each use one shared action. Everyone works on one cauldron with no turns — agree on who clicks.
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.Жар выше 6 или устойчивость ниже 0 сразу: Heat above 6 or stability below 0 ruins the mixture at once. The mixture can’t get colder than 0 or more stable than 6. Essence can’t be removed: take care not to add too much.
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.Разлив не тратит действие. Если рецепт с: Pouring doesn’t use an action. If the recipe is met, the mixture comes out flawless. Otherwise it has a glowing sediment and a sharp smell. You can’t pour plain water with no ingredients.
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.Когда действия закончились, остаётся раз: When the actions run out, all that’s left is to pour the mixture. If no ingredients were added, the GM ends the brewing and starts again. Closing the window doesn’t stop the brewing; the GM can end it and start again.
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.два корня мандрагоры и один уголь салама: two mandrake roots and one salamander coal give heat 4, essence 5 and stability 2 — a finished warming elixir in three actions. All that’s left is to pour.
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.Ингредиенты здесь учебные: инвентарь, зо: The ingredients here are for practice: characters’ inventory, gold and abilities don’t change. The GM decides whether the potion is handed out and what follows. The game is kept until the server restarts.

components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.Улицы спящего города · весь отряд: Streets of the sleeping city · the whole party
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.Ищу путь к убежищу…: Looking for the way to the hideout…
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.Выберите маршрут вместе. После выбора се: Choose a route together. Once you choose, the server reveals the obstacle; you can’t change the road on this leg.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.Обойти и перевести дух: Go around and catch your breath
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.Неудача рывка или укрытия: путь +1, отры: A failed dash or hide: distance +1, lead −2. The energy for a dash is spent whatever the result.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.Отряд начинает с отрывом 4 и запасом сил: The party starts with a lead of 4 and 3 energy. Cover 10 distance in 8 legs.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.Мастер ещё не начал погоню. Когда он под: The GM hasn’t started the chase yet. Once the alarm is raised, the party sees the shared routes.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.набрать 10 пути за 8 участков и сохранит: cover 10 distance in 8 legs and keep the lead above zero. A lead of zero means the party is caught, even right at the hideout.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.Главная улица даёт +1 пути при успехе, п: The main street gives +1 distance on a success, the alleys +2, the rooftops +3. The shorter the way, the harder the check. Choosing a road doesn’t use up a leg by itself.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.Оно случайно выбирается сервером и облег: The server picks it at random, and it makes one of the approaches easier. The exact roll needed is shown on the button. You can’t go back to choosing a road.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.потратьте 1 силу и бросьте к6. Успех даё: spend 1 energy and roll a d6. A success moves you along the route and gives +2 lead.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.бросок без затрат сил, успех даёт продви: a roll that costs no energy; a success moves you along the route and gives +1 lead. Any failed roll gives only +1 distance and −2 lead.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.без броска получите +1 пути, −1 отрыва и: with no roll, get +1 distance and −1 lead and recover 1 energy (up to 4). This also ends the leg.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.После восьмого участка выходы перекрываю: After the eighth leg the exits are sealed. You can still win on the eighth leg if you already have 10 distance and a lead above zero.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.на крышах выпала телега. Для рывка нужно: on the rooftops the cart came up. A dash needs 4+ on a d6. A 5: distance +3, lead +2, energy −1. A 3: distance +1, lead −2, energy −1 all the same.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.Отряд действует совместно, без очереди и: The party acts together, with no turns and no timer. The server rolls the dice. This energy and distance belong to the mini-game only: characters’ abilities, figure positions and combat actions don’t change. Characters’ Athletics, Acrobatics and Stealth checks aren’t connected yet. The GM decides what follows. Restarting the server resets the chase.

components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.Завершить общую партию без победителя?: End the shared game without a winner?
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.Заберите добычу вовремя. Второй дракон с: Take your loot in time. The second dragon burns the turn’s points.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.Вы за столом. Создатель начнёт партию, к: You are at the table. The creator will start the game once everyone has gathered.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.набрать больше сохранённых очков за три: bank more points over three rounds. A tie is a shared victory. Alone, you practise and try to beat your own score.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.Нажмите «Собрать стол». Остальные открыв: Press “Set up the table”. The others open this game and press “Join”. The creator starts the game when everyone is ready. Nobody can join after the start.
Wait for your turn and roll the die.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.1 — дракон, без очков; 2, 3, 4 или 5 — с: 1 is a dragon, no points; 2, 3, 4 or 5 give that many points; 6 is a gem, 10 points at once. Points add up to the sum “at stake”.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.«Сохранить» прибавляет всю сумму на кону: “Bank” adds the whole sum at stake to your score and passes the turn. “Risk it again” rolls the die once more in the same turn.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.Первый дракон не отнимает добычу, но ост: The first dragon takes no loot but stays until the end of the turn. A second dragon in the same turn, even not in a row, burns the whole sum at stake and passes the turn at once. Points banked earlier are not lost.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.Круг заканчивается, когда сходили все. К: A round ends when everyone has played. Everyone gets exactly three turns. Each new turn starts with nothing at stake and no dragons.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.выпали 4, затем 6 — на кону 14. Выпала 1: you roll 4, then 6 — 14 at stake. A 1 comes up — the first dragon, still 14. You may bank 14. If you risk it and get another 1, those 14 burn; your earlier score stays.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.В одном ходу можно бросать несколько раз: You may roll several times in one turn. You can bank only after the first roll, even if it gave 0 points. The score next to a name is the points already banked.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.Закрытие окна не выводит из партии и не: Closing the window does not take you out of the game or skip your turn. If a player disconnects, the creator or the GM can end the game without a winner. Restarting the server resets the game. Characters’ gold and ability scores do not change.

components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Уступить победу сопернику?: Concede the win to your opponent?
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Завершить дуэль без победителя?: End the duel with no winner?
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Другой участник кампании может принять в: Another member of the campaign can accept the challenge.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Вы наблюдаете. Приёмы раскроются, когда: You are watching. The moves are revealed once both opponents have chosen.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Соперник его не видит. Изменить выбор не: Your opponent can’t see it. The choice can’t be changed — waiting for the reveal.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Выберите приём. Он сразу фиксируется; со: Choose a move. It is locked in at once; your opponent sees it only after choosing theirs.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Два участника кампании, по 6 стойкости и: Two campaign members, 6 resolve and 3 stamina each. Everyone else can watch.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Создатель бросает вызов, второй участник: The creator issues the challenge and a second member accepts it. The creator starts the duel. The game needs two different campaign members.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Каждый тайно выбирает один доступный при: Each duelist secretly picks one available move. The choice can’t be changed. Not even a watching GM sees the move before the reveal. Resolve and stamina update only after both decisions.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Урон наносится одновременно. В таблице —: Damage is dealt at the same time. The table shows the damage the row’s move deals to the column’s move. Damage lowers the opponent’s resolve.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.натиск против защиты наносит 0, а защита: a charge against protection deals 0, and protection answers the charge with 1 damage. The charge loses 1 stamina, protection recovers 1. A feint against protection deals 2 damage with no damage back.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Натиск стоит 1 выносливость, финт — 2. З: A charge costs 1 stamina, a feint 2. Protection recovers 1, waiting 2, up to 3. The cost is paid whatever the result. At zero stamina only protection and waiting are available.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Дуэль заканчивается при нулевой стойкост: The duel ends when someone’s resolve hits zero or after 8 rounds. Whoever has more resolve wins; a tie is a draw, including both falling at once. You can concede and give the win to your opponent.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Таймера нет. Закрытие окна сохраняет выб: There is no timer. Closing the window keeps your choice and doesn’t mean conceding. If the opponent disconnects, the creator or the GM can cancel the duel. Restarting the server resets the game. The mini-game’s resolve and stamina don’t change characters’ hit points, resources or items.

components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.Показать верный путь и завершить поиск?: Show the right path and end the search?
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.Запишите, как вы сопоставили даты или на: Note how you matched the dates or found a contradiction.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.Мастер ещё не разложил карту. Когда он в: The GM hasn’t laid out the map yet. Once a story is chosen, the fragments appear for the whole party.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.собрать маршрут из четырёх разных мест в: assemble a route of four different places in the right order. There are five places — one is extra.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.Прочитайте все обрывки. Обращайте вниман: Read all the fragments. Watch the dates and events: an old source may describe a road that can no longer be used.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.Нажимайте названия мест в порядке движен: Click the place names in the order of travel. “Remove” deletes the chosen stop and shifts the ones after it; new stops always go to the end. Changing the route is free.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.Можно отметить сомнительный обрывок и до: You can mark a doubtful fragment and add a note. The whole party sees them. A mark is only your guess: it doesn’t change the right answer.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.«Проверить маршрут» расходует одну из че: “Check the route” uses one of four shared checks. The answer shows how many positions are right but not which. You can’t repeat a route that was already checked, and trying doesn’t use a check.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.Четыре совпадения означают успех, в том: Four matches mean success, including on the last check. After four misses the route locks: the GM can give a hint, show the path based on how the scene went or start a new riddle.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.записка «после башни сразу мост» означае: a note saying “right after the tower comes the bridge” means these places are next to each other. If another fragment was written before the road was destroyed, its directions may be out of date.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.Таймера и автоматических бросков нет. Со: There is no timer and no automatic rolls. The state is shared by the campaign; agree on who changes the route. Characters’ History and Survival aren’t connected yet: the GM runs those checks separately and reveals the hint by hand. The mini-game doesn’t change the Table map, figures or rewards. Closing the window keeps the search until the server restarts.

components/minigames/MiniGamesModal.vue.Выберите занятие для отряда. Открытая па: Choose a pastime for the party. An open game is shared by the campaign’s members.
components/minigames/MiniGamesModal.vue.Собирайте сокровища и вовремя останавлив: Gather treasure and stop in time: the second dragon burns the turn’s loot.
components/minigames/MiniGamesModal.vue.Прочитайте подсказку и совместите три ру: Read the clue and line up three runes. The GM prepares the riddle, the party looks for the answer.
components/minigames/MiniGamesModal.vue.Переносите энергию между стихиями. Найди: Move energy between the elements. Find the balance before the circle fades.
components/minigames/MiniGamesModal.vue.Смешивайте ингредиенты, управляйте жаром: Mix ingredients, control the heat and pour the potion in time.
components/minigames/MiniGamesModal.vue.Выбирайте дороги, берегите силы и оторви: Pick your roads, save your energy and shake off the pursuer before the exits are sealed.
components/minigames/MiniGamesModal.vue.Выбирайте приёмы тайно, угадывайте намер: Pick moves in secret, read your opponent’s intentions and save your stamina.
components/minigames/MiniGamesModal.vue.Сравните старые записи, найдите противор: Compare old records, find the contradictions and restore the way to the goal.
components/minigames/MiniGamesModal.vue.Правила доступны внутри каждой игры. Зак: The rules are inside each game. Closing the window keeps the current game until the server restarts.

components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.День уступает место ночи, а за луной про: Day gives way to night, and after the moon a star awakens.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Открыть замок по решению мастера?: Open the lock by the GM’s decision?
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.На механизме нет надписи. Попросите маст: There is no inscription on the mechanism. Ask the GM to describe the clues in the scene.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Эта комбинация уже есть в истории. Измен: This combination is already in the history. Change the rings.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Повороты бесплатны. Проверка тратит одну: Turning is free. A check spends one attempt for the whole party.
. It is not sent to the players.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.После успешной проверки Магии или инстру: After a successful Arcana or tools check you may reveal a ring. Make the roll itself the usual way.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Выберите решение слева направо и напишит: Choose the solution from left to right and write a clue for the party. Symbols may repeat.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Показать замок отряду: Show the lock to the party
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Мастер ещё не подготовил замок. Когда он: The GM has not prepared the lock yet. Once the puzzle is created, the rings appear for the whole party.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Изменить картинки текущего замка: Change the pictures of the current lock
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Сохранить символы для отряда: Save the symbols for the party
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.выставить три символа в правильном поряд: set three symbols in the right order from left to right. Each ring has six symbols; repeats are allowed. The GM may replace their pictures and names — the rules stay the same.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Замок общий для кампании: любой участник: The lock is shared by the campaign: any member can turn a ring. Agree on who sets the combination.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Повороты не расходуют проверки. Закреплё: Turning spends no checks. A ring fixed by the GM is already right and does not turn.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Тратится одна общая проверка. Ответ «2 /: One shared check is spent. The answer “2 / 3” means two right positions but does not say which. The history keeps every checked variant.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Если последняя проверка неверна, механиз: If the last check is wrong, the mechanism jams. Checking a combination again is not allowed and spends no attempt.
If you are stuck, ask the GM.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Он может раскрыть кольцо, открыть замок: They may reveal a ring, open the lock on a regular roll’s result or prepare a new riddle.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.решение — Солнце → Луна → Звезда. Провер: the solution is Sun → Moon → Star. Checking Sun → Leaf → Star gives “2 / 3”. Turning the middle ring to the Moon and checking again opens the lock.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Таймера и автоматического урона нет. Отк: There is no timer and no automatic damage. The GM decides about opening the door on the map, traps and rewards. Closing the window does not reset the lock; restarting the server does.

Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 2 MB.
components/minigames/RuneSymbolsEditor.v.Не удалось загрузить изображение. Попроб: Could not upload the image. Try again.
components/minigames/RuneSymbolsEditor.v.Замените любые из шести картинок и задай: Replace any of the six pictures and set the names. PNG, JPEG, WebP up to 2 MB. The whole party sees the images after saving.

components/minigames/SealRitualModal.vue.Совместный ритуал · весь отряд: A joint ritual · the whole party
. Pass energy to the neighbours around the circle.
components/minigames/SealRitualModal.vue.· выберите объём и соседнюю печать: · choose the amount and a neighbouring seal
components/minigames/SealRitualModal.vue.Мастер ещё не начал ритуал. Все участник: The GM has not started the ritual yet. All members will see one shared circle.
components/minigames/SealRitualModal.vue.получить по 3 энергии во всех четырёх пе: get 3 energy into each of the four seals before the moves run out. There are always 12 energy in total.
components/minigames/SealRitualModal.vue.Нажмите печать-источник, выберите 1 или: Press the source seal, choose 1 or 2 energy and the neighbour to the left or right around the circle. Nothing passes through the centre. One transfer spends one shared move.
components/minigames/SealRitualModal.vue.В печати может быть от 0 до 6 энергии. Е: A seal holds 0 to 6 energy. If a transfer would exceed 6, the energy stays in place, the move is spent and instability grows by 1. The third overload ends the ritual in failure.
components/minigames/SealRitualModal.vue.«Успокоить круг» снижает нестабильность: “Calm the circle” lowers instability by 1 and also spends a move. A source without enough energy cannot act, and no move is spent.
components/minigames/SealRitualModal.vue.Все действуют совместно, без очереди. Об: Everyone acts together, without turns. Discuss the plan before pressing: the whole party has one supply of moves. Victory is possible on the very last move.
components/minigames/SealRitualModal.vue.у Пламени 5, у Прилива 1. Перенос 2 энер: Flame has 5, Tide has 1. Moving 2 energy from Flame to Tide gives both seals 3 and spends one move.
components/minigames/SealRitualModal.vue.Это отдельный игровой круг: позиции фигу: This is a separate game circle: figure positions, combat actions, damage and rewards do not change automatically. The GM applies the scene’s consequences. Closing the window keeps the ritual until the server restarts.

Close the window? What you entered will not be saved.
components/objects/CreateObjectModal.vue.Не удалось создать объект. Попробуйте ещ: Could not create the object. Try again.
Add a detail that brings your world to life.
components/objects/CreateObjectModal.vue.У каждой истории есть свои действующие л: Every story has its own cast.
components/objects/CreateObjectModal.vue.Окно закрывается крестиком или кнопкой «: The window closes with the cross or “Cancel” — so what you entered isn’t lost by accident.
NPCs are created by the GM.
components/objects/CreateObjectModal.vue.Выбрать существо из бестиария: Pick a creature from the bestiary
components/objects/CreateObjectModal.vue.Персонаж игрока собирается по шагам: рас: A player character is built step by step: race, class, ability scores, background and skills, equipment, spells — with hints at every step.
components/objects/CreateObjectModal.vue.Собрать героя по шагам…: Build a hero step by step…
components/objects/CreateObjectModal.vue.Готовый лист из файла другого приложения: A ready sheet from another app’s file: the import button on the “Party” tab; import comes from mods (the “Mods” window).
components/objects/CreateObjectModal.vue.Например, Элира — хранительница леса: For example, Elira, keeper of the forest
components/objects/CreateObjectModal.vue.По классу — кость хитов, «Дополнительная: By class — Hit Die, Extra Attack, spell slots
components/objects/CreateObjectModal.vue.Подкласс, умения которого считает автома: The subclass whose features automation counts; can be changed later in “Features”
components/objects/CreateObjectModal.vue.Например: «Воин 3 / Волшебник 2» или кла: For example: “Fighter 3 / Wizard 2” or a class not from the SRD
components/objects/CreateObjectModal.vue.Выберите, как представить {value} на сце: Choose how to show {value} on the scene.
components/objects/CreateObjectModal.vue.Как выглядит на столе: How it looks on the table
components/objects/CreateObjectModal.vue.Из библиотеки или файла GLB: From the library or a GLB file
components/objects/CreateObjectModal.vue.PNG, JPEG или WebP · до 5 МБ: PNG, JPEG or WebP · up to 5 MB
components/objects/CreateObjectModal.vue.Сразу поставить на текущую сцену: Place it in the current scene right away

components/objects/LightSourceControl.vu.открытый огонь (гаснет под ливнем): open flame (goes out in a downpour)

components/objects/ModelObjectForm.vue.Быстро: объект из 3D-модели: Quick: an object from a 3D model
components/objects/ModelObjectForm.vue.Загрузить новую модель — GLB, до 25 МБ: Upload a new model — GLB, up to 25 MB

components/objects/ObjectInventory.vue.Положенный предмет уходит со стола. Отда: An item that is put in leaves the table. An item given to a character becomes their owner’s belonging.

components/objects/ObjectStatePanel.vue.сквозь видно и можно пройти: you can see and walk through it
components/objects/ObjectStatePanel.vue.дом, стена, шкаф, закрытая дверь; даёт у: house, wall, cupboard, closed door; gives cover
components/objects/ObjectStatePanel.vue.занавес, густые кусты, дым — пройти можн: curtain, thick bushes, smoke — you can pass, no cover
components/objects/ObjectStatePanel.vue.решётка, витрина, стеклянная стена — вид: bars, display case, glass wall — see-through, gives cover
components/objects/ObjectStatePanel.vue.Ловкость рук против СЛ замка: Sleight of Hand against the lock’s DC
components/objects/ObjectStatePanel.vue.Ловкость рук; провал на 5 и больше — лов: Sleight of Hand; failing by 5 or more triggers the trap
components/objects/ObjectStatePanel.vue.Встаньте вплотную к проходу: Stand right next to the passage
components/objects/ObjectStatePanel.vue.И все мои существа в 10 футах: And all my creatures within 10 feet
components/objects/ObjectStatePanel.vue.Взломать, выбить или искать ловушки може: Your character in this scene can pick the lock, break it down or search for traps.

packages/domain/character/class-features.Короткий отдых: кто потратил кости хитов: Short rest: whoever spends Hit Dice regains an extra d6 HP (d8 from level 9, d10 from 13, d12 from 17) if the bard is conscious. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.У атак по вам нет преимущества, пока вы: Attacks against you don’t have advantage while you aren’t incapacitated. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.«Спрятаться» — бонусным действием (в «Де: Hide as a bonus action (in Actions); you can’t be tracked by magic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Атаки по тем, кого не видите (невидим, с: Attacks against creatures you can’t see (invisible, hidden, you are blinded) have no disadvantage. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Заклинание 6-го уровня (с 13-го — и 7-го: A 6th-level spell (plus 7th from level 13, 8th from 15, 9th from 17) — without a slot, each level once per long rest: a tick in the casting window.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Выбранные заклинания 1-го и 2-го уровня: The chosen 1st- and 2nd-level spells — at their own level without a slot, at will: choose here, a tick in the casting window.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Два выбранных заклинания 3-го уровня — к: Two chosen 3rd-level spells — each once per short rest without a slot: choose here, a tick in the casting window.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Короткий отдых возвращает 4 очка чародей: A short rest restores 4 sorcery points. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Минута маскировки (вне боя): +10 к Скрыт: A minute of camouflage (out of combat): +10 to Stealth while you stand still and do nothing — a step, an attack or a spell ends it.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Пока слышите — знаете, где спрятавшиеся: While you can hear, you know where hidden creatures within 10 feet are: attacks against them lose the “target hidden” disadvantage (invisibility still gives disadvantage). Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.В облике зверя можно сотворять заклинани: You can cast spells in beast form (without costly material components). Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Промах по цели — попадание: галочка в ок: A miss becomes a hit: a tick in the attack window, spent only on a miss. Once per short rest.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Действием — воззвать к божеству: к100 не: As an action — call on your deity: a d100 no higher than your cleric level (always from level 20) and the deity intervenes (the GM decides); after a success — again in 7 days, after a failure — after a long rest.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Действием — закончить одно заклинание на: As an action — end one spell on yourself or an ally nearby (harmful ones first). Charisma times per long rest (at least 1).
packages/domain/character/class-features.Бросая инициативу без единой кости вдохн: Rolling initiative with no inspiration dice left, you regain one. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Бросая инициативу без единого очка ци, в: Rolling initiative with no ki points left, you regain 4. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Минуту взывая к покровителю, вернуть все: Spending a minute entreating your patron, regain all spent pact slots. Out of combat, once per long rest.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Ярость кончается раньше срока, только ес: Your rage ends early only if you fall unconscious or end it yourself. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Сила и Телосложение +4, предел — 24. Сам: Strength and Constitution +4, maximum 24. Automatic on reaching level 20.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Без доспехов КД = 13 + Ловкость (щит мож: Without armor AC = 13 + Dexterity (a shield is allowed); +1 HP maximum per sorcerer level. Automatic: in the creation wizard and on level-up.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Цель преуспела в спасброске от вашего за: A target that succeeds on the save against your cantrip still takes half its damage but no other effects. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Заклинание 1–5 уровня с уроном — урон на: A damaging spell of levels 1–5 deals maximum damage (a tick in the casting window). The first time per long rest is free; after that — 2d12 necrotic damage per spell level at once, +1d12 per level for each further time; resistance and immunity don’t help.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Вне боя (после отдыха) выберите вид урон: Out of combat (after a rest) choose a damage type — resistance to it until you choose another. Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from magical or silvered weapons ignores it — the GM decides this.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Кости лечения ваших заклинаний не бросаю: Your healing spell dice aren’t rolled — each gives its maximum. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Выберите одно: «Уйти от толпы» — атаки п: Choose one: Escape the Horde — opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage; Multiattack Defense — when a creature hits you, its later attacks against you this turn are against AC +4; Steel Will — advantage on saves against being frightened.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Выберите одно: «Залп» — действием дально: Choose one: Volley — as an action, a ranged attack against every creature within 10 feet of a point; Whirlwind Attack — as an action, a melee attack against every creature within 5 feet of you. Each target gets its own attack roll.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Падая, реакцией уменьшить урон от падени: When falling, as a reaction reduce the falling damage by 5 × monk level. Automatic (in combat — if your reaction is free).
packages/domain/character/class-features.Получив урон от существа в 5 футах, реак: When a creature within 5 feet damages you — as a reaction, a melee weapon attack against it. “Ready” — automatic, with your best melee weapon, if your reaction is free.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Выберите одно: «Увёртливость» — спасброс: Choose one: Evasion — a “half on success” Dexterity save: success — no damage, failure — half; Stand Against the Tide — when an enemy misses you with a melee attack, as a reaction you force it to repeat the attack against another creature next to it (your enemy); Uncanny Dodge — when an attacker you can see hits you, as a reaction halve the damage. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Действием, 4 очка ци: на минуту — невиди: As an action, 4 ki points: for a minute — invisibility and resistance to all damage except force.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Попав безоружным ударом, за 3 очка ци —: On an unarmed strike hit, for 3 ki points — deadly vibrations in the target’s body (for as many days as your monk levels; one target at a time). You can end them as an action: the target makes a Constitution save against your ki DC; failure — 0 HP, success — 10d10 necrotic damage.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Попав атакой по существу, можно мгновенн: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can instantly hurl it through the lower planes: until the end of your next turn it is gone from the battlefield (incapacitated, unseen); on returning it takes 10d10 psychic damage unless it is a fiend. Once per long rest.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Действием на минуту: вас окружает яркий: As an action for a minute: bright light surrounds you for 30 feet (and dim light 30 more); an enemy starting its turn in the bright light takes 10 radiant damage; saves against spells of fiends and undead have advantage. Once per long rest.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Круг Земли: Поступь по земле: Circle of the Land: Land’s Stride
packages/domain/character/class-features.Немагическая труднопроходимая местность: Nonmagical difficult terrain costs no extra movement. Automatic: the scene’s terrain squares count as normal.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Бонусным действием — драконьи крылья: ск: As a bonus action — dragon wings: a flying speed equal to your walking speed until you fold them (also a bonus action). A flyer isn’t hindered by terrain or pit traps.
packages/domain/character/class-features.К своей проверке характеристики (и навык: You can add a Bardic Inspiration die to your own ability (and skill) check — one inspiration is spent. A tick in Checks.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Действием — до конца вашего следующего х: As an action — until the end of your next turn you and allies within 30 feet make saves against fear and charm with advantage.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Бонусным действием: ячейка — в очки чаро: As a bonus action: a slot into sorcery points (as many as its level), or points into a slot up to 5th level (1st — 2 points, 2nd — 3, 3rd — 5, 4th — 6, 5th — 7).
packages/domain/character/class-features.«Дикий облик» — сколько угодно раз. Само: Wild Shape — any number of times. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Проверка Скрытности — с преимуществом, е: Stealth checks have advantage if you moved no more than half your speed this turn. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.В первом раунде боя — два хода: на свою: In the first round of combat — two turns: at your initiative and at it −10 (a second entry in the order “…: thief’s reflexes”). Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.После долгого отдыха вы под «Убежищем» (: After a long rest you are under Sanctuary (DC 8 + Wisdom + proficiency) until the next long rest; attacking or harming with a spell ends it. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Выберите тип существ (ещё один с 6-го и: Choose a creature type (one more at levels 6 and 14): with Foe Slayer at level 20 — a damage bonus against them. Advantage on Survival and Intelligence about them — the GM decides.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Раз в ход попав по избранному врагу — к: Once per turn when you hit a favored enemy — add your Wisdom modifier to damage. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Действием — существо в 30 футах, что вид: As an action — a creature within 30 feet that can see you makes a Wisdom save (DC 8 + proficiency + Charisma); on a failure it is frightened until the end of your next turn; then extend it with an action. One that resists is immune for a day.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Действием, 5 очков: аура на 60 футов на: As an action, 5 points: a 60-foot aura for a minute (concentration) — fear or charm. An enemy starting its turn in the aura makes a Wisdom save against your spell DC; on a failure it is frightened or charmed while the aura lasts; one that resists is immune for a day.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Всегда под «Защитой от добра и зла»: абе: Always under Protection from Evil and Good: aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead attack you with disadvantage and can’t charm or frighten you. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Круг Земли: Защита природы: Circle of the Land: Nature’s Ward
packages/domain/character/class-features.Иммунитет к яду (урон и отравление) и бо: Immune to poison (damage and poisoning) and disease; elementals and fey can’t charm or frighten you. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Круг Земли: Святилище природы: Circle of the Land: Nature’s Sanctuary
packages/domain/character/class-features.Зверь или растение, атакующее вас, снача: A beast or plant attacking you first makes a Wisdom save against your spell DC; on a failure the attack doesn’t happen. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Без доспехов КД = 10 + Ловкость + Телосл: Without armor AC = 10 + Dexterity + Constitution; a shield is allowed. When multiclassing it isn’t taken twice.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Без доспехов и щита КД = 10 + Ловкость +: Without armor or a shield AC = 10 + Dexterity + Wisdom. When multiclassing it isn’t taken twice.

packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Дальнобойным оружием: дальняя дистанция: With ranged weapons: no disadvantage at long range, half and ¾ cover don’t hinder — automatic; −5 to hit / +10 damage — a tick in the attack window.

Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Враг в 5 футах не даёт помехи вашим даль: An enemy within 5 feet doesn’t impose disadvantage on your ranged attacks (weapon and spell); a bonus hand crossbow shot adds the modifier to damage. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Заклинания с броском атаки — дальность в: Spells with an attack roll — double range, half and ¾ cover don’t hinder. Automatic.

packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Урон дробящий, колющий и рубящий — на 3: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage is reduced by 3 (heavy armor is assumed worn). Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Вне боя, речь 10 минут: до 6 своих в 30: Out of combat, a 10-minute speech: up to 6 allies within 30 feet (and you) gain temporary HP equal to level + Charisma; once per short rest.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Глефа, алебарда, пика, боевой посох, коп: Glaive, halberd, pike, quarterstaff, spear: a bonus butt-end attack — 1d4 bludgeoning (a bonus-action attack with this weapon); an enemy entering your reach provokes an opportunity attack. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.«Толкнуть» — и бонусным действием (в «Де: Shove — also as a bonus action (in Actions). Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Ритуалы — как у волшебника: «ритуалом» в: Rituals like a wizard: “as a ritual” in the casting window, no slot, +10 minutes. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Спасброски против заклинаний того, кто в: Advantage on saves against spells of a creature within 5 feet of you; casting nearby — attack it as a reaction (a prompt; NPCs do it themselves); your damage gives disadvantage on its concentration save. Automatic.

packages/domain/character/races.ts.Спасброски против очарования — с преимущ: Advantage on saves against being charmed; magic can’t put you to sleep (Sleep doesn’t work). Automatic.

packages/domain/character/races.ts.Спасброски Интеллекта, Мудрости и Харизм: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves against magic. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/races.ts.Хиты упали до 0, но не убит сразу — вмес: Dropping to 0 HP without dying outright — drop to 1 HP instead. Once per long rest. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/races.ts.Критическое попадание рукопашным оружием: A melee weapon critical hit — one extra weapon damage die. Automatic.
