packages/domain/spells/template/options..заклинатель попадает по цели атакой: the caster hits the target with an attack
packages/domain/spells/template/options..по цели попадают атакой: the target is hit by an attack
packages/domain/spells/template/options..цель атакует или творит заклинание: the target attacks or casts a spell
packages/domain/spells/template/options..за каждые два круга выше: for every two slot levels above

A reaction can’t be cast as a ritual.
packages/domain/spells/template/validate.Компонент М отмечен, а материал не описа: Component M is checked, but the material isn’t described.
A cantrip isn’t cast as a ritual.
packages/domain/spells/template/validate.Нет ни одного действия — заклинание ниче: There are no actions — the spell will do nothing in play.
packages/domain/spells/template/validate.Действие касается целей, а целей у закли: The action affects targets, but the spell has no targets.
packages/domain/spells/template/validate.Действие касается «всех в области», а об: The action affects “everyone in the area”, but there is no area.
Hit point threshold: the formula can’t be parsed.
packages/domain/spells/template/validate.«Половина при успехе» — только у спасбро: “Half on success” is only for a saving throw or a check.
packages/domain/spells/template/validate.«Половина при успехе», а урона при прова: “Half on success”, but there is no damage on a failure.
packages/domain/spells/template/validate.«Когда» про зону, а действие не внутри п: “When” refers to a zone, but the action is not inside a “Zone on the map” effect.
packages/domain/spells/template/validate.«Командой», но ни одна команда (раздел Ж: “By a command”, but no command (section G) performs it.
packages/domain/spells/template/validate.Вид урона «из параметра», а параметра ви: The damage type is “from a parameter”, but section E has no damage type parameter.
packages/domain/spells/template/validate.«Пока не спасётся», но повторного спасбр: “Until it saves”, but there is no repeat saving throw.
packages/domain/spells/template/validate.Срок «как у заклинания», а заклинание мг: Duration “same as the spell”, but the spell is instantaneous — the condition ends at once.
packages/domain/spells/template/validate.Форма зоны «как в разделе Г», а в Г — не: The zone shape is “as in section D”, but D is not an area.
packages/domain/spells/template/validate.Команда выполняет действие, которого нет: The command performs an action that doesn’t exist.
Move the zone — but there is no zone.
Switch mode — but there are no modes.
packages/domain/spells/template/validate.Команды у мгновенного заклинания не успе: Commands of an instantaneous spell won’t have time to be useful.
The increase amount is not set.
packages/domain/spells/template/validate.Рост по уровню персонажа бывает у загово: Growth by character level is for cantrips.
Refers to an action that doesn’t exist.
packages/domain/spells/template/validate.Урон намного выше обычного для {value}:: Damage is far above the usual for {value}: ~{damage} vs. ~{expected}.

packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Вмещает 1 кубический фут или 30 фунтов с: Holds 1 cubic foot or 30 pounds of gear; more can be strapped to the outside.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Спальный мешок для ночёвки под открытым: A sleeping roll for nights under the open sky.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Горит 1 час: яркий свет на 5 фт. и тускл: Burns for 1 hour: bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.10 хитов; разорвать — проверка Силы со С: 10 hit points; bursting it takes a DC 20 Strength check.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Преимущество к проверкам Силы, где помог: Advantage on Strength checks where its leverage can be applied.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Крюк на верёвке: зацепиться за край стен: A hook on a rope: catch the edge of a wall or ledge to climb up.
For driving pitons, nails and stakes.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Ставится действием. Наступивший — спасбр: Set as an action. A creature stepping on it makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or takes 1d4 piercing damage and can’t move farther than the chain (3 ft.). Freeing it takes an action and a DC 13 Strength check; each failure deals 1 more piercing damage.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Горит 6 часов на фляге масла: яркий свет: Burns for 6 hours on a flask of oil: bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.
Burns for 6 hours on a flask of oil: bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. As an action, lower the hood to reduce the light to dim light in a 5-foot radius.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Горит 6 часов на фляге масла: конусом яр: Burns for 6 hours on a flask of oil: bright light in a 60-foot cone and dim light for an additional 60 feet.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.С ключом. Без ключа — проверка Ловкости: Comes with a key. Without it — a DC 15 Dexterity check with thieves’ tools.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Сковывают Маленькое или Среднее существо: Bind a Small or Medium creature. Escaping takes a DC 20 Dexterity check, breaking them a DC 20 Strength check; 15 hit points. Come with a key.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Стальное ручное зеркальце: заглянуть за: A steel hand mirror: peek around a corner, signal.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Металлический клин: забить в трещину и з: A metal spike: drive it into a crack and tie a rope to it.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Сушёная еда в дорогу на один день: вялен: Dry food for one day on the road: jerky, hardtack, nuts.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.2 хита; разорвать — проверка Силы со СЛ: 2 hit points; bursting it takes a DC 17 Strength check.
2 hit points; bursting it takes a DC 17 Strength check. Half the weight of hempen rope.
For digging pits, ditches and graves.
A simple portable canvas shelter for two.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Кремень, огниво и трут. Зажечь факел, ла: Flint, fire steel and tinder. Lighting a torch, lamp or lantern takes an action; any other fire takes a minute.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Горит 1 час: яркий свет на 20 фт. и туск: Burns for 1 hour: bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. A hit with a burning torch deals 1 fire damage.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Действием рассыпать на квадрат 10 × 10 ф: As an action, spill them over a 10-foot square. A creature entering it makes a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or falls prone. A creature moving at half speed needs no save.
As an action, spread them over a 5-foot square. A creature entering it makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or takes 1 piercing damage, stops moving and has its speed reduced by 10 feet until it regains at least 1 hit point. A creature moving at half speed needs no save.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Бутылочка чернил: писать, рисовать карты: A bottle of ink: for writing, drawing maps, copying spells.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Книга волшебника: 100 листов пергамента: A wizard’s book: 100 vellum pages for spells.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Действием облить существо в 5 фт. или бр: As an action, splash it on a creature within 5 feet or throw it up to 20 feet (a ranged attack with an improvised weapon): the target takes 5 fire damage if it catches fire within a minute. Poured on a 5-foot square and lit, it burns for 2 rounds, dealing 5 fire damage to a creature entering or ending its turn there.
As an action, splash it on a creature within 5 feet or throw it up to 20 feet (a ranged attack with an improvised weapon): on a hit, 2d6 acid damage.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Действием бросить до 20 фт. (дальнобойна: As an action, throw it up to 20 feet (a ranged attack with an improvised weapon): on a hit, the target takes 1d4 fire damage at the start of each of its turns. Putting it out takes an action and a DC 10 Dexterity check.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Выпивший час совершает с преимуществом с: A creature that drinks it has advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour. It confers no benefit to undead or constructs.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Действием облить существо в 5 фт. или бр: As an action, splash it on a creature within 5 feet or throw it up to 20 feet (a ranged attack with an improvised weapon): a fiend or undead takes 2d6 radiant damage.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Выпить или напоить — действием: восстана: Drinking it or giving it to someone takes an action: regains 2d4 + 2 hit points.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.10 применений. Действием — стабилизирова: 10 uses. As an action, stabilize a creature at 0 hit points without a Wisdom (Medicine) check.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Боеприпасы для луков. После боя половину: Ammunition for bows. After a battle, half of the expended ammunition can be recovered in a minute.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Боеприпасы для арбалетов. После боя поло: Ammunition for crossbows. After a battle, half of the expended ammunition can be recovered in a minute.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Боеприпасы для пращи. После боя половину: Ammunition for slings. After a battle, half of the expended ammunition can be recovered in a minute.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Мешочек с материальными компонентами: за: A pouch of material components: replaces those without a listed cost.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Фокусировка чародея, колдуна и волшебник: A focus for sorcerers, warlocks and wizards: used in place of material components without a listed cost.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Фокусировка жреца и паладина: держать в: A focus for clerics and paladins: held in hand, worn visibly or borne on a shield.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Фокусировка друида и следопыта: вместо м: A focus for druids and rangers: used in place of material components without a listed cost.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Отмычки, напильник, зеркальце на ручке,: Lock picks, a small file, a mirror on a handle, scissors. Proficiency adds your proficiency bonus to checks to pick locks and disarm traps.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Шлямбуры, наконечники на сапоги, перчатк: Pitons, boot tips, gloves and a harness. As an action, anchor yourself: you can’t fall more than 25 feet from that point and can’t climb farther away until you undo the anchor.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Ножницы, ступка, мешочки. Владение — бон: Clippers, a mortar and pestle, pouches. Proficiency adds your proficiency bonus to checks to identify or apply herbs; needed to make antitoxin and potions of healing.
Cosmetics, hair dye and small props. Proficiency adds your proficiency bonus to checks to create a disguise.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Простая одежда горожанина или крестьянин: Plain clothes of a townsfolk or peasant.
packages/domain/srd/gear.ts.Крепкая одежда для дальней дороги: плащ: Sturdy clothes for a long journey: a hooded cloak, boots.
Fine clothes for banquets and the court.

packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.В тусклом свете в пределах 60 фт. видит: Within 60 ft. sees in dim light as if it were bright, and in darkness as if it were dim (only shades of gray).
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Преимущество на спасброски от очарования: Advantage on saves against being charmed; magic can’t put you to sleep.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Преимущество на спасброски от яда, сопро: Advantage on saves against poison, resistance to poison damage.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Владение боевым топором, ручным топором,: Proficiency with the battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer and warhammer.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Инструменты кузнеца, пивовара или каменщ: Smith’s, brewer’s or mason’s tools — your choice.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Удвоенный бонус мастерства к проверкам И: Double proficiency bonus on Intelligence (History) checks related to stonework.
Heavy armor doesn’t reduce your speed.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Максимум хитов больше на 1 за каждый уро: HP maximum is 1 higher per level.
Instead of sleeping — 4 hours of meditation.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Владение длинным и коротким мечами, коро: Proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow and longbow.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Один заговор волшебника на выбор; базова: One wizard cantrip of your choice; the spellcasting ability is Intelligence.
One more language of your choice.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Выпала 1 на к20 при атаке, проверке или: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack, check or save, reroll and use the new result.
Advantage on saves against being frightened.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Может проходить сквозь пространство суще: Can move through the space of any creature at least one size larger.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Может пытаться спрятаться, даже когда ег: Can attempt to hide even when obscured only by a creature at least one size larger.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Общий и ещё один на выбор: Common and one more of your choice
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Тип дракона-предка задаёт оружие дыхания: Your dragon ancestor’s type sets the breath weapon and resistance.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Действием: область по происхождению, спа: As an action: an area by your ancestry, a save (DC 8 + Constitution modifier + proficiency bonus), 2d6 damage, half on a success. Recharges after a short or long rest.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Сопротивление урону типа своего происхож: Resistance to your ancestry’s damage type.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Преимущество на спасброски Интеллекта, М: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves against magic.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Удвоенный бонус мастерства к проверкам И: Double proficiency bonus on Intelligence (History) checks about magic items, alchemy and technology.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Владение инструментами ремесленника; мож: Proficiency with artisan’s tools; can build tiny clockwork devices.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Общий, Эльфийский и ещё один на выбор: Common, Elvish and one more of your choice
Proficiency in two skills of your choice.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.+1 к двум характеристикам на выбор, кром: +1 to two abilities of your choice other than Charisma.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Если хиты опускаются до 0, но вы не умер: When you drop to 0 HP but aren’t killed, you drop to 1 HP instead. Once per long rest.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.При критическом попадании рукопашным ору: On a melee weapon critical hit — one extra weapon damage die.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Знает заговор чудотворство; с 3-го уровн: Knows the thaumaturgy cantrip; from level 3 — hellish rebuke, from level 5 — darkness (once per long rest). The spellcasting ability is Charisma.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Раса не из SRD: название, черты и языки: A race not from the SRD: the name, traits and languages are agreed with the GM; +2 to one ability and +1 to another.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Бонусным действием на 1 минуту: преимуще: As a bonus action for 1 minute: advantage on Strength checks and saves, +2 to Strength melee weapon damage, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage. Twice per long rest.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Без доспехов КД = 10 + модификатор Ловко: Without armor AC = 10 + Dexterity modifier + Constitution modifier; a shield is allowed.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Бонусным действием даёт союзнику к6 к од: As a bonus action, gives an ally a d6 for one check, attack or save. A number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (at least once) per long rest.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Владение тяжёлыми доспехами. Благословен: Heavy armor proficiency. Bless and cure wounds are always prepared.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Лечащее заклинание 1-го круга и выше вос: A healing spell of 1st level or higher restores an extra 2 + the spell’s level HP.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Мудрость; 3 заговора; готовит заклинаний: Wisdom; 3 cantrips; prepares Wisdom modifier + level spells; 2 1st-level slots.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Булава, чешуйчатый доспех, щит, лёгкий а: Mace, scale mail, shield, light crossbow
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Мудрость; 2 заговора; готовит заклинаний: Wisdom; 2 cantrips; prepares Wisdom modifier + level spells; 2 1st-level slots. Doesn’t wear metal armor or shields.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Бонусным действием восстанавливает 1к10: As a bonus action regains 1d10 + fighter level HP. Once per short rest.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Кольчуга, длинный меч и щит, лёгкий арба: Chain mail, longsword and shield, light crossbow
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Без доспехов и щита КД = 10 + модификато: Without armor or a shield AC = 10 + Dexterity modifier + Wisdom modifier.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Безоружный удар и монашеское оружие: Лов: Unarmed strikes and monk weapons: Dexterity instead of Strength, d4 damage; after attacking with the action — an unarmed strike as a bonus action.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Действием чувствует небожителей, исчадий: As an action senses celestials, fiends and undead within 60 ft. 1 + Charisma modifier times per long rest.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Запас лечения 5 × уровень паладина хитов: A healing pool of 5 × paladin level HP per long rest; 5 HP from the pool cures a disease or poison.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Кольчуга, длинный меч и щит, метательные: Chain mail, longsword and shield, javelins
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Тип врагов на выбор: преимущество на про: A type of enemy of your choice: advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track them and Intelligence checks to recall information about them; one more language.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Избранная местность: удвоенный бонус мас: Favored terrain: double proficiency bonus on Intelligence and Wisdom checks about it; the party can’t become lost.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Удвоенный бонус мастерства к двум навыка: Double proficiency bonus for two skills you are proficient in.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Раз в ход +1к6 урона по цели, если атака: Once per turn +1d6 damage to a target if the attack has advantage or an able ally is next to the target (finesse or ranged weapon).
The secret language and signs of rogues.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Тип дракона-предка; знаете Драконий язык: Your dragon ancestor’s type; you know Draconic.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Максимум хитов больше на 1 за уровень; б: HP maximum 1 higher per level; without armor AC = 13 + Dexterity modifier.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Опустив хиты враждебного существа до 0,: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 HP you gain temporary HP: Charisma modifier + warlock level (at least 1).
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Харизма; 2 заговора, 2 известных заклина: Charisma; 2 cantrips, 2 known spells, 1 1st-level slot that recharges after a short rest.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Интеллект; 3 заговора, книга заклинаний: Intelligence; 3 cantrips, a spellbook with 6 1st-level spells; prepares Intelligence modifier + level; 2 1st-level slots.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Раз в день после короткого отдыха восста: Once a day after a short rest, regains slots with a total level up to half the wizard level (rounded up).
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.+2 к урону оружием в одной руке, если др: +2 damage with a weapon in one hand when the other is free.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Двуручным или универсальным оружием в дв: With a two-handed or versatile weapon in both hands: you can reroll 1s and 2s on damage dice.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Со щитом реакцией создаёт помеху атаке п: With a shield, as a reaction impose disadvantage on an attack against an adjacent ally.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Атака вторым оружием добавляет модификат: The off-hand attack adds the ability modifier to damage.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Служили в храме. Владение Проницательнос: You served in a temple. Proficiency in Insight and Religion, two languages of your choice.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Вы и спутники можете рассчитывать на бес: You and your companions can expect free healing and shelter at temples of your faith.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.игровой набор на выбор, сухопутный транс: one gaming set of your choice, land vehicles
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Годы в войске, ополчении или страже. Вла: Years in an army, a militia or the watch. Proficiency in Athletics and Intimidation.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Вы знаете, как устроены лагерь и караул:: You know how a camp and a guard work: where the posts stand, whom to ask for orders and how to get rations.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Годы над книгами и свитками. Владение Ма: Years over books and scrolls. Proficiency in Arcana and History, two languages of your choice.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Если вы не знаете ответа, то обычно знае: When you don’t know an answer, you usually know which library, archive or scholar to ask.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.воровские инструменты, игровой набор на: thieves’ tools, one gaming set of your choice
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Жили не в ладу с законом. Владение Обман: You lived at odds with the law. Proficiency in Deception and Stealth.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.В любом большом городе вы найдёте скупщи: In any large city you can find a fence, a smuggler or someone who passes on a message without questions.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.инструменты ремесленника на выбор, сухоп: one set of artisan’s tools of your choice, land vehicles
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Простой человек, однажды вставший за сво: A common person who once stood up for their own. Proficiency in Animal Handling and Survival.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.В родных краях о вас рассказывают истори: Back home people tell stories about you, so common folk trust you more readily and share rumours.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.игровой набор на выбор: one gaming set of your choice
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Род с гербом, землями и долгами. Владени: A house with a coat of arms, lands and debts. Proficiency in History and Persuasion, one language of your choice.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Вас принимают при дворах и в домах знати: Courts and noble houses receive you, and servants and guards speak to you with respect.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Долго жили вдали от людей. Владение Меди: You lived far from people for a long time. Proficiency in Medicine and Religion, one language of your choice.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.В уединении вам открылось нечто важное:: In solitude you learned something important: a truth, a secret or an omen. Decide with the GM what it is.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.музыкальный инструмент на выбор: one musical instrument of your choice
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Выросли в глуши, вдали от городов. Владе: You grew up in the wilds, far from towns. Proficiency in Athletics and Survival, one language of your choice.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Вы помните местность, по которой прошли,: You remember the land you have crossed, and in the wilds you can usually find water and food for yourself and your companions.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.набор для грима, музыкальный инструмент: disguise kit, one musical instrument of your choice
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Сцена, площадь и таверна — ваш дом. Влад: The stage, the square and the tavern are your home. Proficiency in Acrobatics and Performance.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Где можно выступить, там вам найдутся но: Wherever you can perform, you get a bed and a supper for a show.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.инструменты ремесленника на выбор: one set of artisan’s tools of your choice
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Мастер своего дела и член цеха. Владение: A master of your craft and a guild member. Proficiency in Insight and Persuasion, one language of your choice.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Мастера вашего ремесла помогут советом,: Masters of your craft help with advice, work or shelter, and the guild stands up for you before the authorities.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Годы на палубе. Владение Атлетикой и Вос: Years on deck. Proficiency in Athletics and Perception.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Вы договоритесь о бесплатном месте на су: You can get free passage on a ship for yourself and your companions in return for work on deck.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Выросли на улице, сами по себе. Владение: You grew up on the streets on your own. Proficiency in Sleight of Hand and Stealth.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Вы знаете проходы, крыши и дворы, по кот: You know the passages, roofs and yards that get you across town twice as fast.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Жили обманом и ловкостью. Владение Обман: You lived by tricks and quick hands. Proficiency in Deception and Sleight of Hand.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.У вас есть второе имя с бумагами, знаком: You have a second name with papers, acquaintances and a past. You can wear it until someone digs deeper.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Лечили людей в деревне, городе или при в: You treated people in a village, a town or an army. Proficiency in Medicine and Insight.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.В знакомых краях всегда найдётся тот, ко: In familiar lands there is always someone you nursed back to health who will shelter or help you.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Распутывали чужие тайны за плату или по: You unravelled other people’s secrets for pay or by duty. Proficiency in Investigation and Insight, one language of your choice.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Стражники и судейские охотно делятся с в: Guards and court clerks readily share news of cases and suspects with you.
packages/domain/srd/heroes.ts.Своя: два навыка на выбор, остальное — с: Custom: two skills of your choice, the rest with the GM.

packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает с преимуществом броски атаки п: Has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one able ally is within 5 ft. of it.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает с преимуществом проверки Мудро: Has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
Has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Может в каждый свой ход совершать бонусн: Can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.На солнечном свету совершает с помехой б: In sunlight it has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает с преимуществом спасброски от: Has advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Добавляет +{bonus} к КД против одной рук: Adds +{bonus} to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so it must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.понимает языки, которые знал при жизни,: understands the languages it knew in life but can’t speak
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Если цель — существо, она должна преуспе: If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC {dc} Strength save or be knocked prone.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает с преимуществом проверки Мудро: Has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.
Has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
Has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Если {what} переместился по прямой хотя: If the {what} moves at least {distance} feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra {average} ({extra}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC {dc} Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Не может пользоваться слепым зрением, по: Can’t use its blindsight while deafened.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Прыгает в длину до 10 фт. и в высоту до: Its long jump is up to 10 feet and its high jump is up to 5 feet, with or without a running start.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Вне воды может задерживать дыхание на 30: While out of water, can hold its breath for 30 minutes.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает с преимуществом проверки Ловко: Has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Чернильное облако (перезаряжается после: Ink Cloud (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Под водой выпускает чернила: сфера радиу: Underwater, it releases ink: a 5-foot-radius sphere around it is heavily obscured for 1 minute (a strong current disperses it sooner). Then it can take the Dash action as a bonus action.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Цель схвачена (СЛ высвобождения 10). Пок: The target is grappled (escape DC 10). Until this grapple ends, the octopus can’t use its tentacles on another target.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Вылетая из досягаемости врага, не провоц: Doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает с преимуществом рукопашные ата: Has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn’t have all its hit points.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Подражает простым звукам, что слышал: шё: Can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a person whispering, a baby crying, or an animal chittering. Spotting the imitation takes a DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Лазает по сложным поверхностям, в том чи: Can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without an ability check.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Касаясь паутины, знает, где находится лю: While in contact with a web, it knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
Ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Цель должна преуспеть в спасброске Телос: The target must succeed on a DC 9 Constitution saving throw or take 2 (1d4) poison damage.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Цель должна совершить спасбросок Телосло: The target must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, taking 5 (2d4) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Стирж прицепляется к цели. Пока он прице: The stirge attaches to the target. While attached, it doesn’t attack; instead, at the start of each of its turns the target loses 5 (1d4 + 3) HP to blood loss. The stirge detaches by spending 5 ft. of movement — once it has drained 10 HP or the target dies. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach it.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Если урон опускает хиты зомби до 0, он с: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 HP, it makes a Constitution save with DC 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 HP instead.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Заклинатель 1-го уровня, базовая характе: A 1st-level spellcaster whose spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). Prepared cleric spells: cantrips — light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy; 1st level (3 slots) — bless, cure wounds, sanctuary.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Если кабан переместился по прямой хотя б: If the boar moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a tusk attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength save or be knocked prone.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Неутомимый (восстанавливается после коро: Relentless (recharges after a short or long rest)
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Если кабан получает не больше 7 урона и: If the boar takes 7 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 HP, it is reduced to 1 HP instead.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Если пантера переместилась по прямой хот: If the panther moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength save or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the panther can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Если конь переместился по прямой хотя бы: If the horse moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the horse can make another attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает две атаки: одну укусом и одну: Makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Бонусным действием может переместиться н: As a bonus action, it can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature it can see.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Раз в ход наносит дополнительно 7 (2d6): Once per turn, deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 ft. of an able ally of the hobgoblin.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Когда гнолл в свой ход опускает хиты сущ: When the gnoll reduces a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack on its turn, it can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает две рукопашные или две дальноб: Makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.
Can hold its breath for 15 minutes.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает две рукопашные атаки, каждую —: Makes two melee attacks, each with a different weapon.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Цель схвачена (СЛ высвобождения 12). Пок: The target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the crocodile can’t bite another target.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Рукопашное оружие наносит одну дополните: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage (already included in the attacks).
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Если багбир застал существо врасплох и п: If the bugbear surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Если цель — существо, но не эльф и не не: If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution save or be paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Касаясь паутины, знает точное местополож: While in contact with a web, it knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Игнорирует ограничения перемещения, вызв: Ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Цель совершает спасбросок Телосложения с: The target makes a DC 11 Constitution save, taking 9 (2d8) poison damage on a failure or half on a success. If the poison reduces the target to 0 HP, it is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining HP, and is paralyzed while poisoned this way.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Цель опутана паутиной. Действием опутанн: The target is restrained by webbing. As an action, the restrained target can make a DC 12 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing has AC 10, 5 HP, vulnerability to fire damage, and immunity to bludgeoning, poison and psychic damage.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.глухота, испуг, истощение, окаменение, о: deafened, frightened, exhaustion, petrified, blinded, poisoned, charmed, paralyzed
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.В области антимагического поля недееспос: Incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, it must succeed on a Constitution save against the caster’s spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Пока доспехи неподвижны, их не отличить: While the armor remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal suit of armor.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает две атаки скимитаром; вторая —: Makes two attacks with its scimitar; the second has disadvantage.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Когда видимое существо атакует вожака, о: When a creature the goblin boss can see targets it with an attack, the boss chooses another goblin within 5 ft. of it; the two goblins swap places, and the chosen goblin becomes the target instead.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.В каждый свой ход может бонусным действи: On each of its turns, can take the Dash, Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Наносит дополнительно 7 (2d6) урона, поп: Deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when it hits with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 ft. of an able ally of the spy and the spy doesn’t have disadvantage.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.гигантских орлов; понимает Общий и Ауран: Giant Eagle, understands Common and Auran but can’t speak them
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает две атаки: одну клювом и одну: Makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.гигантских лосей; понимает Общий, Эльфий: Giant Elk, understands Common, Elvish, and Sylvan but can’t speak them
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Если тигр переместился по прямой хотя бы: If the tiger moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the tiger can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает три рукопашные атаки: две ским: Makes three melee attacks: two with its scimitar and one with its dagger. Or two ranged attacks with its daggers.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Заклинатель 4-го уровня, базовая характе: A 4th-level spellcaster whose spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 11, +3 to hit with spell attacks). Prepared cleric spells: cantrips — light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy; 1st level (4 slots) — command, inflict wounds, shield of faith; 2nd level (3 slots) — hold person, spiritual weapon.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.глухота, испуг, истощение, ослепление, о: deafened, frightened, exhaustion, blinded, charmed, prone
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Заполняет всё своё пространство. Другие: It takes up its entire space. Other creatures can enter the space, but a creature that does so is engulfed by the cube and has disadvantage on the saving throw. Creatures and objects inside the cube can be seen. It can hold one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Даже на виду куб замечают проверкой Мудр: Even in plain sight, spotting a cube that hasn’t moved or attacked takes a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check. A creature that tries to enter the cube’s space while unaware of it is surprised by the cube.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Куб перемещается на расстояние не больше: The cube moves up to its speed; while doing so it can enter Large or smaller creatures’ spaces. A creature whose space it enters makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On a success, it can move 5 ft. aside. On a failure, it is engulfed: it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage, is restrained, can’t breathe, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the cube’s turns. As an action, a DC 12 Strength check can pull a creature or object out of the cube; the one pulling takes 10 (3d6) acid damage.
A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the ghast must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution save or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a success, it is immune to this ghast’s Stench for 24 hours.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Вурдалак и упыри в пределах 30 фт. от не: The ghast and any ghouls within 30 ft. of it have advantage on saves against effects that turn undead.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Если цель — существо, но не нежить, она: If the target is a creature other than undead, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution save or be paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Действием принимает облик предмета или в: As an action, it takes the form of an object or reverts to its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Its equipment isn’t transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Прилипает ко всему, что касается его. Су: It adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic is grappled (escape DC 13). Checks to escape have disadvantage.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Пока мимик неподвижен, его не отличить о: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает с преимуществом броски атаки п: Has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.В облике предмета цель прилипает к мимик: In object form, the target is stuck to the mimic.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.В начале своего хода может получить преи: At the start of its turn, it can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает с преимуществом проверки Мудро: Has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Если минотавр переместился по прямой хот: If the minotaur moves at least 10 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength save or be pushed up to 10 ft. away and knocked prone.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Всегда помнит любой путь, которым прошёл: Can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает две атаки длинным мечом. Если: Makes two longsword attacks. If it has a shortsword drawn, it can also make a shortsword attack.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает с преимуществом спасброски от: Has advantage on saves against being frightened.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Лидерство (восстанавливается после корот: Leadership (recharges after a short or long rest)
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.На 1 минуту рыцарь может особым приказом: For 1 minute, the knight can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that it can see within 30 ft. of it makes an attack roll or a saving throw; the creature adds a d4 to its roll. The effect ends if the knight is incapacitated.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает три атаки: две клешнями и одну: Makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its sting.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Цель схвачена (СЛ высвобождения 12). У с: The target is grappled (escape DC 12). The scorpion has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Цель совершает спасбросок Телосложения с: The target makes a DC 12 Constitution save, taking 22 (4d10) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.В хвосте 24 шипа. Израсходованные отраст: Has twenty-four tail spikes. Used spikes regrow when it finishes a long rest.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает три атаки: одну укусом и две к: Makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws, or three with its tail spikes.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Дракон выдыхает огонь 15-футовым конусом: The dragon exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in it makes a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 24 (7d6) fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает с преимуществом проверки Мудро: Has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saves against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned and knocked unconscious.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Пока одна голова спит, другая бодрствует: When one of its heads is asleep, its other head is awake.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает две атаки: одну боевым топором: Makes two attacks: one with its greataxe and one with its morningstar.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.В начале своего хода восстанавливает 10: Regains 10 HP at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn’t function at the start of its next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 HP and doesn’t regenerate.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает три атаки: одну укусом и две к: Makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает три рукопашные атаки или две д: Makes three melee attacks or two ranged attacks.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Если цель — существо Среднего размера ил: If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength save or be knocked prone.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Заклинатель 9-го уровня, базовая характе: A 9th-level spellcaster whose spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). Prepared wizard spells: cantrips — fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation; 1st level (4 slots) — detect magic, mage armor, magic missile, shield; 2nd (3) — misty step, suggestion; 3rd (3) — counterspell, fireball, fly; 4th (3) — greater invisibility, ice storm; 5th (1) — cone of cold.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Совершает две атаки: одну укусом и одну: Makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its stinger. While flying, it can use its claws in place of one other attack.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Цель совершает спасбросок Телосложения с: The target makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Дракон выдыхает ядовитый газ 30-футовым: The dragon exhales poisonous gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in it makes a DC 14 Constitution save, taking 42 (12d6) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.
packages/domain/srd/monsters.ts.Дракон выдыхает огонь 30-футовым конусом: The dragon exhales fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in it makes a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 56 (16d6) fire damage on a failure or half on a success.

rules/rulesGlossary.ts.Бросаете к20 дважды и берёте больший рез: You roll a d20 twice and take the higher result (advantage) or the lower one (disadvantage). If you have both, they cancel out and the roll is normal.
rules/rulesGlossary.ts.Половинное — +2 к КД и спасброскам Ловко: Half cover — +2 to the target’s AC and Dexterity saving throws. Three-quarters cover — +5. Total cover — the target can’t be targeted directly by an attack or a spell that requires seeing it.
rules/rulesGlossary.ts.Отдельный ресурс хода: даёт только то ум: A separate resource of the turn: you get it only for a feature or a spell that explicitly says it takes a “bonus action” — it is not half of a regular action.
rules/rulesGlossary.ts.Одна в ход, в том числе не в свой — напр: One per round, including outside your own turn — for example, an opportunity attack when an enemy leaves your reach without taking the Disengage action.
rules/rulesGlossary.ts.Каждая занятая клетка стоит вдвое больше: Each square of it costs double movement — a step through it “eats” 2 feet of speed instead of one.
rules/rulesGlossary.ts.0 хитов без мгновенной смерти — в начале: At 0 hit points without instant death — at the start of your turn roll a d20: 10 or higher is a success, otherwise a failure. Three successes — stable; three failures — death. A natural 20 brings back 1 hit point, a natural 1 counts as two failures.
rules/rulesGlossary.ts.Тратится на коротком отдыхе, чтобы восст: Spent during a short rest to regain hit points: a roll of the class’s die plus the Constitution modifier. A long rest restores half of the spent dice (at least one).
rules/rulesGlossary.ts.Прибавка к броскам, в которых есть владе: Added to rolls you are proficient in — skills, saving throws, weapon or spell attacks. It grows with the character’s level, from +2 to +6.
rules/rulesGlossary.ts.Мастер дарует за хорошую игру или удачну: The GM grants it for good roleplaying or a clever idea; it is spent for advantage on one next roll — an attack, a check or a saving throw.
rules/rulesGlossary.ts.Плут раз в ход добавляет кости урона, ес: Once per turn a rogue adds extra damage dice if attacking with advantage, or if an ally who isn’t incapacitated is next to the target and the attack doesn’t have disadvantage.
rules/rulesGlossary.ts.Шесть уровней, каждый следующий добавляе: Six levels, each one adds its own: disadvantage on checks, half speed, disadvantage on attacks and saving throws, half the hit point maximum, speed 0, death at the sixth.
